Scarlet & Violet series · SSP

Surging Sparks

Released November 8, 2024 · 252 cards

StandardExpanded

Surging Sparks is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on November 8, 2024. Its main set has 191 cards, plus 61 secret rares numbered beyond the set (252 in total). It includes 207 Pokémon, 43 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
